title: Tire Wear and Thermals ReSpin — Compat Tires
tag_line: Optional Respin-selectable GT3 tire JBeams (meshes stay in companion car mods)
message:
[B]Tire Wear and Thermals ReSpin — Compat Tires[/B]

Optional [B]companion[/B] to the core ReSpin thermals/wear mod. Ships [B]JBeam-only[/B] selectable [I]*_Respin[/I] tire clones so popular third-party GT3 packs can sit in a ReSpin-friendly thermal window.

[HR][/HR]
[B]Install[/B]
1. Install / enable [B]Tire Wear and Thermals ReSpin[/B] (core zip — thermals + UI).
2. Install / enable [B]this[/B] compat-tires zip.
3. Install the matching car mod (Scintilla GT3 Racing Parts and/or Pigniteon ETK Racing) for meshes.
4. Parts → tires → pick a name ending in [B]Respin[/B] (Scintilla also has Hard/Medium/Soft Slick).

[HR][/HR]
[B]Why a separate zip?[/B]
BeamNG mounts vehicle-classified zips at [I]vehicles/[/I] only. Compat tires must not live inside the core ReSpin zip or the Apps / Lua never mount.

[HR][/HR]
